comment: Phenom People career sites to enumerate (src/scrapers/phenom.js).
Unlike the other ATS platforms, Phenom gives every employer a vanity domain, so
there is no shared host to harvest tokens from and nothing in the GitHub feeds
points at it. List the sites explicitly here. This is where the Canadian banks
and telcos live — they run Phenom and appear on no other source Jobify scrapes.
Each entry: { host, company?, country?, lang? }. country/lang default to US
English; set them where the site is localized (Bell serves ca/en_ca). Verify a
candidate host by POSTing {ddoKey:'refineSearch'} to https://{host}/widgets — a
200 with a refineSearch.data.jobs array means it's Phenom.
A dead or non-Phenom host costs one skipped request, nothing more.
